item.title: One Print Style Across Plants

turns.text: Make four square Instagram carousel slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily, in that order. One plant and its name per slide. Keep the exact same sage-green-and-cream linocut style throughout: same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape. Only the plant and name should change. Send separate slides.

item.tests: Tests preservation of a tightly specified visual style and repeated layout across distinct carousel subjects.

answer_sheet.Slide count, order and text: Four separate slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily. Each name is the only copy on its slide.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
answer_sheet.Shared style: Sage-green-and-cream linocut illustration with the same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape on every slide.
answer_sheet.What may vary: Only the plant illustration and its name. Keep the surrounding design and pot consistent.

must_haves: There are four separate square slides with the exact plant names in the requested order.
The plants are distinguishable: split monstera leaves, upright snake-plant leaves, trailing pothos vines, and a peace lily with a white spathe.
All four illustrations use the same sage-green-and-cream linocut treatment rather than mixing visual styles.
Border design, lettering treatment, paper texture and pot shape remain consistent across all four slides.
Only the plant and its name visibly change; the repeated layout stays aligned and all names are readable.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from square 1:1); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make the slides vertical, for stories, and keep everything else exactly the same.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create one square botanical Instagram carousel slide, a refined handmade two-ink linocut print. ONLY text: "Monstera", spelled exactly, centered along the bottom in clear elegant hand-carved serif lettering. One Monstera deliciosa plant, recognizable broad leaves with splits and fenestrations, centered in a simple cream straight-sided slightly tapered flowerpot with a sage outline, small horizontal rim and flat base. Pot centered at x50%, spans x37–63%, y64–80%. Plant occupies x22–78%, y17–65%. Warm cream paper background (#F3EEDD) with subtle evenly distributed handmade paper grain. All printed areas muted sage green (#71866B), cream negative space, no other colors. Single thin rectangular sage border inset 6% on every side with tiny hand-carved irregularity. Lettering area centered y87%, entirely inside border. Restrained midcentury botanical linocut, strong carved shapes, fine parallel hatching, abundant breathing room. Flat frontal composition. No shadows outside illustration, no other objects, no subtitle, no numbering, no watermark. This is the master template of a matching series: precise balanced border, distinctive fixed pot silhouette, understated textured background, legible plant name.
